'''31174''' was an elevator located in the [[Wizard's Tower/Legends|Wizard's Tower]] of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].

==Description==
Elevator ''31174'' was a large, grey elevator with a cuboid interior more than capable of accommodating 10 people. There were ten lights on the inside; three on each non-door wall and one large light on the ceiling. The same type of ceiling light was on the top and bottom of the elevator's exterior. ''31174'' was the middle elevator of its group of five sharing the same shaft. ''31174'' was secured to the shaft by two railings that ran along the left and right sides of the elevator.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used this elevator while rescuing [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. While the duo was ascending up to the top of the tower, the lift had been shut down. Obi-Wan Kenobi sent [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to remedy this, but Anakin impatiently cut a hole in the roof of the lift. Meanwhile, R2-D2 managed to reactivate it, first sending it down and forcing Anakin to hang off a ledge, but then correcting its direction to up. Two [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]] held Anakin at gunpoint, but the Jedi leaped onto ''31174'' as it ascended by, and the two droids were destroyed. ''31174'' was later lost when the rear half of the ''Invisible Hand'' broke in two above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
